name: Central Retail Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: Central Retail Corporation Public Company Limited operates as a multi-format multi-category retailing platform in Southeast Asia and Italy. It operates through Fashion, Hardline, and Food segments. The company sells fashion merchandise and other consumer products; consumer electronics, home decoration, construction materials, and DIY products; and grocery, organic and health foods, beverages, and consumer staples under a portfolio of retail banners. As of December 31, 2019, it operated 1,934 stores across 51 provinces in Thailand; 132 stores across 37 provinces in Vietnam; and 9 department stores in 8 cities in Italy. Central Retail Corporation Public Company Limited was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
